mapper.sql: id, period_start, period_end, status, record_count, file_path, error_message, created_at, completed_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO audit_log_export_batch (period_start, period_end) VALUES (#{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_log_export_batch SET status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL, completed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE audit_log_export_batch SET status = 'COMPLETED', record_count = #{recordCount}, file_path = #{filePath}, error_message = NULL, completed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE audit_log_export_batch SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
